name: Josie Tomkow

items.text: In September 2020, The Ledger reported that a 2018 traffic citation listed Tomkow's address as Dade City, outside the Polk County House district she represented. That raised questions about whether she lived in her district. Tomkow said she lives in Polk City and called the continued allegations tiring.
items.why: This is a residency question bearing on commitment to the area, but I found no official finding or ruling that she broke the residency rule, and she denies it.

for_review: The Ledger original was blocked (access denied). I relied on LkldNow's summary of it, so the citation details, the full response and any follow-up are unread. I found no court or official residency finding. A related residency complaint came up in late 2025 and early 2026: opponent Brian Nathan asked agencies to investigate whether she lives in South Tampa. WFLA/Yahoo reported it, and I saw only search snippets. Her House voter registration shows Polk City. I did not find the outcome of any investigation. A Substack post on the same question was opinion and says it does not claim she lives outside the district. The owner-site search (Alex Jones, Stew Peters, Ryan Dawson, Infowars) returned nothing about her. I used one search on it; a name-specific search for those sites was not run separately beyond that combined query.
